findings.finding: The eta=3% rolling path has more seven-year waste than eta=1%, although every local profit-floor constraint passes. This is consistent with path dependence and must be treated as a robustness result, not a global Pareto monotonicity claim.

The greedy baseline leaves some normal-price crop demand unused in every year. Demand is an upper bound rather than a service requirement, so this does not violate the model; the warnings are retained as baseline behavior evidence.
